┌─ Help: The map and its legend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Legend                                                                                                                                   │
│   You       @ you  % scout marker  + plan end  ◄ objective                                                                               │
│   People    p player  T trainer  $ vendor  B banker  H binder  g guard  Q quest person  & board  D door  “ said, for 4 s                 │
│             » chat names you                                                                                                             │
│   Quest     ! new  ? hand in  ? in progress  m quest mob  D next door                                                                    │
│   Events    ; scout point  v raiders appear  ◆ raiders head for                                                                          │
│   Creatures m mob  M target  x dead  r rare  * loot  ~ not yours  c camp                                                                 │
│   Ground    # building  ^ rock  ≈ water  : ford  = bridge  " forest  · road  . floor  ░ zone edge                                        │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Marks and pointers                                                                                                                       │
│   Gold is the quest's alone. A gold ! is somebody with something new for you; a gold ? is a hand-in that is ready, a grey ? a quest in   │
│   progress. A board that has something to take or hand in is gold. Mobs that count for a contract you hold are gold, and the next door   │
│   on your way is a gold D. Shape says it as well as colour.                                                                              │
│   World events and scouting have their own marks. The scout points (;) are gold, as your own scout marker (%) is. A world event's        │
│   raiders appear at a purple v and head for a purple ◆. Hover over any of them for its name, or Option-click to walk there; Nearby lists │
│   the named ones.                                                                                                                        │
│   When your objective is off the map an arrow at the edge points to it, with its name and distance (◄ Gorran 23m); the status line names │
│   it too. Nearby lists what matters to your quest first, tagged [step 2] or [2/3].                                                       │
│   The zone edge is the ░ line: walking ends there. Beside it, a zone line is a door (D).                                                 │
│   The line under the log changes with what you stand next to: the door, the person, the drop, the mobs in view.                          │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Danger                                                                                                                                   │
│   Services (traders, talk, the board, the character view, contracts) are panels in the map's area: the You, Target and Nearby panels     │
│   stay beside them. A screen never hides a fight. When something attacks you its border turns red, the status line names it and your     │
│   health, and nothing closes by itself. Esc leaves the screen; the attacker is already your target, so F fights it. -bell rings the      │
│   terminal's bell too.                                                                                                                   │
│   The You panel says "in combat" and who is attacking. A hard or deadly mob is called out as DANGER.                                     │
│                                                                                                                                          │
